system.description:
You have been trained to move while attention lies elsewhere.

When using the Sneak (Stealth) action, you may move up to your Speed rather than the normal distance allowed by the action.

Ghostwalk does not allow you to Hide or Sneak where you lack the cover or concealment normally required to do so.

Not automated: the system's Sneak action does not measure how far you move; with Ghostwalk you may move up to your Speed with it. You still need cover or concealment to Hide or Sneak.
